title: PhysMaster: Building an Autonomous AI Physicist for Theoretical and Computational Physics Research
abstract: arXiv:2512.19799v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Advances in LLM reasoning and tool use have enabled agentic science, yet frontier theoretical and computational physics remains challenging because research requires deep domain expertise, long-horizon reasoning, and reliable numerical computation. We introduce PRL-Bench, a research-reproduction benchmark adapted from 100 Physical Review Letters papers across major areas of modern physics. PRL-Bench distills realistic research workflows into traceable tasks with explicit intermediate artifacts and diverse evaluation rubrics; each task is estimated by domain experts to require more than six hours for a specialized PhD student to reproduce independently. Evaluations show that existing agents remain unreliable on extended research workflows. We therefore present PhysMaster, a scientific agent combining adaptive MCTS-based multi-trajectory exploration with hierarchical memory to improve long-horizon robustness and knowledge accumulation.

translated_title: PhysMaster：构建用于理论与计算物理研究的自主AI物理学家
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.19799v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型推理和工具使用方面的进展已使智能体科学成为可能，但前沿理论和计算物理仍然具有挑战性，因为研究需要深厚的领域专业知识、长程推理和可靠的数值计算。我们引入了PRL-Bench，这是一个研究复现基准，改编自现代物理主要领域的100篇《物理评论快报》论文。PRL-Bench将现实研究流程提炼为可追踪的任务，并带有明确的中间产物和多样化的评估标准；每个任务经领域专家估计，需要专业博士生独立复现超过六小时。评估显示，现有智能体在扩展研究流程上仍不可靠。因此，我们提出了PhysMaster，这是一种科学智能体，结合了基于自适应蒙特卡洛树搜索的多轨迹探索与分层记忆，以提高长程鲁棒性和知识积累。
tldr: 本文提出了PRL-Bench基准和PhysMaster智能体，后者通过自适应MCTS多轨迹探索与分层记忆机制，显著提升了长程理论物理研究的可靠性和知识积累能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PRL-Bench benchmark and PhysMaster agent, which enhances long-horizon reliability and knowledge accumulation in theoretical physics research through adaptive MCTS-based multi-trajectory exploration and hierarchical memory.
